desc: Preprocess conflicting pairs: for each pair, compute $L=\min(a,b)$ and $R=\max(a,b)$. Group pairs by $L$.
Implement the sweep-line to compute $min1[l]$ and $min2[l]$ for each $l$.
Compute the base invalid subarray count for the full set of pairs using the minimum $R$ values.

For each pair removal, determine the new invalid count: for each $l$, if the minimum $R$ was provided by the removed pair, use the second minimum; otherwise, use the minimum. Sum up the invalid subarrays for each removal.
The answer is the maximum over all removals of (total subarrays - invalid subarrays).
Implement the solution in Python, ensuring efficient heap operations and array accesses.
